title: backup check/verify report a finished-run failure while a copy is running
body:
Found 2026-09-15 on rhadamanth. hv stopped the copy to install macOS 27; a new copy was then running (sdcopy pid 61366, image attached, 11% done). Both backup_check and backup_verify still reported "last copy did NOT succeed (OUTCOME_FAILED)" and exited 1, without mentioning the running copy. vc read that output as "the backup is failing", which was wrong.

Cause: recentRuns in tiles.json records finished runs only, so a copy in progress cannot appear there. The liberator can already see one: backup_maintain checks for the sdcopy process inline.

Fix: one _backup_copying probe, used by the run assessment and by backup_maintain. While a copy is running, always say so. When the latest recorded run was cancelled or failed but the last successful copy is within BACKUP_MAX_AGE_DAYS, report it as not a fault. A running copy does not excuse a stale backup, no successful copy at all, or an empty history.
